name: NickTGMods
author: NickTG
description: NickTG's challenge pack: RarityLock (lock Joker rarity, Joker-only duplicates), ForceEdition (force every Joker's edition), BossRush (every blind is a Boss Blind), and BurnDeck (every played card burns), each on its own tab, plus a pack-wide Include-skips switch. BossRush requires the BossRush lovely.toml in this folder. All modules ship disabled; opt in per tab.
